name: Kagi Security
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a managed security firm that watches over small and mid-sized companies: cloud-white and pale-mist ground, night-navy text and bands, one signal-indigo accent, Instrument Serif over Inter. The home page opens on the analysts' room at night under a translucent indigo chevron, with white label chips for the menu and captions; then what we watch, how we respond as four photographed chapters, a few honest figures over rotated ghost words and a rounded photo card, the analysts by name, three plans with monthly per-device fees, notes from the desk and an invitation to a first call. With What we watch, How we respond, Analysts, Getting started, Plans and fees, About, Monthly notes, Contact and Journal. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.
